messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up — NexaHealth just signed an LOI and asked for an enterprise commit conversation. They want committed throughput + reserved GPUs. Key asks: 2,000,000 tokens/day, ~150 RPS peak for chat embeddings+responses, SLA 99.95, HIPAA + KMS integration. Need a preheat and autoscale plan + rough pricing by EOD. Any blockers?

rick_se: Sounds doable but we should break it down. Quick calc: 2M tokens/day ~= 23 TPS sustained. Peak 150 RPS is request rate not tokens; assume 75 tokens per request avg -> 11.25k tokens/s at peak. We should size for peak for latency SLOs.

chen_oncall: For latency SLOs and reserved pool I'd recommend reserving a baseline of 3 GPUs for steady-state + 4 GPUs burstable (reserved) to hit peak with headroom. If model is quantized 8-bit 70B/13B -> numbers change; which model are they planning to run?

emma_sales: Customer prefers an open LLM we verified — they mentioned a distilled 13B variant for cost. Also asked about preheat/warm KV cache for conversations.

rick_se: OK assume 13B quantized. With our perf bench, 1xA100-sized node does ~1.8k tokens/s for generation under 13B q4 - so to hit 11.25k tokens/s at peak we'd want ~7 nodes. That's consistent with chen's baseline+burst. Plan: reserved pool = 3 nodes (always on), reserved burst capacity = 4 nodes (idle but reserved), autoscale policy to spin-from-reserved first.

karen_product: We should also surface cost tradeoffs: reserved GPUs vs. burst credits. If they commit annually, reserved pricing makes sense. Also call out cold-start KV warmup time (~90s for large contexts) and recommend a 30min prewarm window before big campaigns.

chen_oncall: Autoscale config proposal (for SRE handoff):
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  reserved_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 12
  prewarm_seconds: 1800  # 30m
  scale_policy: route-by-latency
```
Keep prewarm_seconds for KV cache and prefix caching. Reserved replicas are billed as reserved capacity but not counted as active billing in burst credits.

emma_sales: Security asks: they require KMS + key rotation logs and an inventory answer for the security questionnaire. @sec_bot can you confirm what we can provide from Private + Dedicated?

sec_bot: For Dedicated we support KMS integrations (customer-managed keys) + audit logs for all key operations. We also have SOC2 + HIPAA controls on Private deployments. I'll attach a min set of language for the questionnaire in a follow-up thread, but for the presales doc say: "KMS (bring-your-own-key), audit logs, isolated VPC, and annual penetration testing".

rick_se: One operational note — if they plan heavy burst windows (marketing launches) we should schedule a dry-run: run synthetic for 30m at 120% expected peak to validate KV warmup and autoscale behavior. Recommend 24–48h notice for preheat.

emma_sales: I'll tell the customer: preliminary sizing = reserved 3 + reserved-burst 4, autoscale to 12 for headroom; preheat 30m before big events; dry-run recommended. Need costs for reserved baseline + expected overage. Can someone sketch a quick $/day estimate?

rick_se: Rough ballpark (internal quick math): A13-style reserved GPU = $X/day (use finance calc). For the 3 baseline + 4 reserved-burst = 7 reserved -> multiply. I'll ping finance for exact commit pricing and send a short note. :thumbsup:

chen_oncall: I'll prepare an ops runbook snippet for handoff (KV warmup steps, test script, rollback plan) and drop it in the deal folder.

deploy_bot: deploy scheduled: preheat-checklist template created at /deals/nexa/preheat-checklist.md

emma_sales: Perfect. Thanks team — I’ll compile this into the customer email and ask NexaHealth for model confirmation and launch windows. Follow-ups in #sales-threading if we need more detail. :rocket:
